PAGE TITLE: OTHER INFORMATION AGENCY RESPONSE TO OIG REPORT ON NASA’S TOP MANAGEMENT AND PERFORMANCE CHALLENGES

KEY FACTS:
- NASA leveraged its Enterprise Pricing Office (EPO) responsible for contract pricing, audit, and closeout capability across NASA's enterprise.
- Under Procurement Fraud Avoidance and Improper Use of Grant Funds, NASA added strategic efforts including Sustaining Vendor Management, Pricing Academy, and Development of Prices Paid Capabilities.
- NASA launched initiatives to increase monitoring of grants by integrating revisions to 2 CFR, “Office of Management and Budget Guidance for Federal Financial Assistance,” into policy and processes.
- Transaction Testing Reviews require the grant officer to randomly select a quarter of grantee expenditures and review for questionable costs at least once every five years for each award during its period of performance.
- Grant officers review Federal Financial Reports on a semi-annual basis and grantees must provide explanations for any on-hand cash and anomalies identified.
- In FY 2024, NASA conducted 968 Transaction Testing Reviews and 6,738 Federal Financial Report reviews.
